  renderTopbar();
}

/* ---------- audio (tiny synth, no assets) ---------- */
let AC=null;
function beep(f,d,type,v,dl){
  if(!S.sound)return;
  try{
    AC=AC||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
    if(AC.state==='suspended')AC.resume();
    const o=AC.createOscillator(),g=AC.createGain();
    o.type=type||'sine';o.frequency.value=f;
    o.connect(g);g.connect(AC.destination);
    const t0=AC.currentTime+(dl||0);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t0);
    g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v||.05,t0+.012);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t0+d);
    o.start(t0);o.stop(t0+d+.03);
  }catch(e){}
}
const SFX={
  click:()=>beep(520,.05,'triangle',.025),
  ok:()=>{beep(660,.09,'sine',.05);beep(880,.13,'sine',.05,.08)},
  no:()=>beep(165,.22,'sawtooth',.035),
  step:()=>beep(430,.06,'triangle',.03),
  hit:()=>{beep(200,.14,'square',.04);beep(140,.18,'sawtooth',.03,.04)},
  win:()=>{[523,659,784,1046].forEach((f,i)=>beep(f,.16,'sine',.05,i*.11))},
  level:()=>{[392,523,659,880].forEach((f,i)=>beep(f,.13,'triangle',.05,i*.09))},
  boss:()=>{[110,98,110,131].forEach((f,i)=>beep(f,.2,'sawtooth',.045,i*.16))}
};

/* ---------- confetti ---------- */
const fxCanvas=$('#fx'),fctx=fxCanvas.getContext('2d');
let parts=[];
function sizeFx(){fxCanvas.width=innerWidth;fxCanvas.height=innerHeight}
sizeFx();addEventListener('resize',sizeFx);
function burst(n,x,y,colors){
  n=n||80;
  const cx=x==null?innerWidth/2:x, cy=y==null?innerHeight*0.35:y;
  const cols=colors||['#28517C','#517DAB','#7698BE','#E3AF3C','#F2D57E','#0C2D53'];
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*PI*2, sp=3+Math.random()*7;
    parts.push({x:cx,y:cy,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp-3,g:.16,life:1,
      s:3+Math.random()*5,c:cols[Math.floor(Math.random()*cols.length)],
      rot:Math.random()*PI,vr:(Math.random()-.5)*.3});
  }
  if(!burst._loop)fxLoop();
}
function fxLoop(){
  burst._loop=true;
  fctx.clearRect(0,0,fxCanvas.width,fxCanvas.height);
  parts=parts.filter(p=>p.life>0);
  for(const p of parts){
    p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.vy+=p.g;p.life-=.012;p.rot+=p.vr;
    fctx.save();fctx.translate(p.x,p.y);fctx.rotate(p.rot);
    fctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(p.life,0);fctx.fillStyle=p.c;
    fctx.fillRect(-p.s/2,-p.s/2,p.s,p.s*0.6);fctx.restore();
  }
  if(parts.length){requestAnimationFrame(fxLoop)}
  else{fctx.clearRect(0,0,fxCanvas.width,fxCanvas.height);burst._loop=false}
}

/* ---------- MCQ builder ---------- */
function Q(q,ans,wrongs,why,hint){
  const norm=s=>String(s).replace(/\u2212/g,'-');
  q=norm(q);ans=norm(ans);
  const opts=[norm(ans)];
  for(const w of wrongs){const s=norm(w);if(!opts.includes(s))opts.push(s)}
  if(opts.length<4){
    const num=parseFloat(String(ans).replace(/[^\d.\-]/g,''));
    if(isFinite(num)){
      let d=2;
      while(opts.length<4&&d<64){
        [num+d,num-d,num+d/2].forEach(v=>{const s=fmt(v);if(opts.length<4&&!opts.includes(s))opts.push(s)});
        d*=2;
      }
    }
    const pool=['None of these','Cannot be determined','All of these'];
    let i=0;while(opts.length<4&&i<pool.length){if(!opts.includes(pool[i]))opts.push(pool[i]);i++}
  }
  const four=shuf(opts.slice(0,4));
  return {q,opts:four,a:four.indexOf(String(ans)),why,hint};
}

/* ---------- palette (brand-derived world accents) ---------- */
const HUES={
  num:['#1F4E79','#E2EDF6','#0B2540'], poly:['#C08A2D','#F7EDD8','#7A5A12'],
  grid:['#33658A','#E0EBF3','#143A55'], line:['#2E75B6','#DFECF7','#123B63'],
  euc:['#0C2D53','#DCE5EE','#041D3D'], ang:['#4A7BA6','#E2EEF6','#1C3F5E'],
  tri:['#1D6E79','#DCEFF1','#0B3A40'], quad:['#28517C','#E1EAF2','#0C2D53'],
  circ:['#0F6690','#DBEBF5','#083A52'], area:['#517DAB','#E4EDF4','#24466B'],
  sol:['#22708F','#DBEDF3','#0C3D4E'], dat:['#4E6E8E','#E2EAF1','#22384C']
};
function setHue(id){
  const h=HUES[id]||HUES.quad,r=document.documentElement.style;
  r.setProperty('--ac',h[0]);r.setProperty('--acsoft',h[1]);r.setProperty('--acink',h[0]);
  r.setProperty('--acdeep',h[2]);
}
function irlHTML(c){
  if(!c.irl)return '';
  return '<div class="irl-card"><div class="irl-kick"><span>🌏</span> REAL-WORLD RADAR — where this concept shows up in life</div>'
   +c.irl.map(u=>'<div class="irl-row"><span class="iri">📍</span><span>'+u+'</span></div>').join('')+'</div>';
}
function applyHueInline(el,id){
  const h=HUES[id]||HUES.quad;
  el.style.setProperty('--ac',h[0]);el.style.setProperty('--acsoft',h[1]);
  el.style.setProperty('--acink',h[0]);el.style.setProperty('--acdeep',h[2]);
}

/* ---------- world registry (filled in data parts) ---------- */
let WORLDS=[];
const worldById=id=>WORLDS.find(w=>w.id===id);
function conceptById(cid){
  for(const w of WORLDS){const c=w.concepts.find(c=>c.id===cid);if(c)return{w,c}}
  return null;
}
function conceptState(c){
  if(S.covered[c.id])return'done';
  if(S.learned[c.id])return'prog';
  return'new';
}
function worldCov(w){return w.concepts.filter(c=>S.covered[c.id]).length}
